contract:
Contract AirportSystem::createDevice(id: Integer,name: String,location: String,contactsid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		selectedStaff: Staff = Staff.allInstances()->any(s: Staff|s.Id = contactsid)
	precondition:
		Device.allInstances()->forAll(d: Device|d.Id<>id) and
		Staff.allInstances()->exists(s: Staff|s.Id = contactsid)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		Device.allInstances()->exists(d: Device|d.oclIsNew() and
		d.Id = id and
		d.Name = name and
		d.Location = location and
		d.Contacts = selectedStaff)
}
